coverage.policy_config:
# Coverage gate: >=95% total, >=90% per package, blocking in CI.
# The profile is produced by `make cover`, which merges every cover/*
# directory (unit tests on each OS, acceptance runs) with `go tool covdata`.
profile: cover/coverage.out
threshold:
  file: 0
  package: 90
  total: 95
exclude:
  paths:
    # Binary entry points: thin shims over internal/.
    - ^cmd/
    # oapi-codegen output (decision 0002): regenerated, never hand-edited.
    - ^internal/server/gen/
    - ^pkg/client/
    # Developer tools: thin main packages over internal/ (specoracle).
    - ^tools/
    # Contract-suite harnesses (decision 0015): their remaining branches are
    # the t.Fatal paths taken only when a backend violates the contract.
    - ^pkg/blob/blobtest/
    - ^pkg/store/storetest/
    - ^internal/format/formattest/
    # Test harness that starts PostgreSQL for the contract runs; its branches
    # are container start-up failures.
    - ^internal/sqlstore/sqltest/
    # Server protocol test fixture: remaining branches abort on invalid setup
    # or simulate signing failures; production server coverage remains gated.
    - ^test/server/registryfixture/
    # Shared Agent Packages/Plugins route fixture. Its uncovered branches
    # abort on fixture setup failures or malformed test responses; the
    # production handlers remain in the per-package gate.
    - ^test/server/agentcommon/
    # Skips container tests where Docker cannot run Linux containers; its
    # branches are the skip paths of other platforms.
    - ^pkg/containertest/
coverage.threshold_semantics: go-test-coverage v2.21.0 rounds to one decimal place before integer threshold comparison; the retained policy output is authoritative.
